title: Uniformization with positive bisectional curvature
exact_target: Is every connected noncompact complex n-manifold, $n\geq 1$, carrying a complete smooth Kähler metric with strictly positive holomorphic bisectional curvature biholomorphic to $C^{n}$?

sources.citation: OpenAI, manuscript citation page. Source of the formulation motivating this local problem.
